html:
CRYPTO NEWS — August 20, 2026

Markets woke up in full risk-on mode. Bitcoin crushed through $71K, Ethereum exploded 18.7% to $2,280, and the Fear & Greed gauge pivoted hard from yesterday's 46 (Fear) to today's 62 (Greed). Total cap is now $2.45T on a 7.35% surge. The mood shift happened fast—too fast for most traders to catch their breath. Funding rates remain flat across BTC, ETH, and SOL, so leverage isn't stretched yet, but greed is creeping in at 73/100 on the e-trade.ai thermometer. This is the setup where quick money piles in before the first retracement.

TODAY'S HIGHLIGHTS

Spot Bitcoin ETFs Pull $700M in Inflows as Institutional Bid Accelerates
The biggest single-day inflow in months hit spot Bitcoin ETFs, with $517–700M in fresh capital flooding in as BTC tagged $71K. This isn't retail FOMO—this is institutions treating the dip below $70K last week as a buy signal. The setup: institutional flows provide a floor under volatility swings. What it means for your trade: Long positions have institutional backing now, which raises the bar for a sharp dump. Watch for these flows to reverse if BTC closes below $68K on a daily basis; that's when the bid usually dries up fast.

HYPE Token Launches 20% Rally on Trump Legal Path Signal
Hyperliquid's native token jumped 20%+ as political signals suggested a legit regulatory pathway in the US. Volume spiked to $1.59B, 5.2x the average, and the token sits at $72.52. This is a classic political-risk-reversal trade—event risk pricing out and capital flowing in. What it means for your trade: High-volume breakouts on macro news catalysts often hold on follow-through buying, but this moves fast enough to whip leverage traders. Enter on the actual breakout confirmation above $72, not on the jump itself; trailing stops are your friend here.

Bearish Bets Get Crushed for Record $3B in Liquidations as Short Squeeze Fires
Traders who shorted the bounce got liquidated for a record $3 billion as BTC ripped higher. The biggest victim was a $24M blowup on Ethereum in 12 seconds from a trader holding a $49M short profit. Liquidations breed volatility, not stability. What it means for your trade: This is the tail end of a short squeeze. Volume is still elevated and sentiment is manic, so expect one more leg higher before the final dump. But position size now—if you're adding longs here at $71K, you're chasing, and the risk-reward is off.

Trump Hosts Crypto CEOs, Potential US Bitcoin Treasury Move Gains Traction
White House meetings with major crypto leaders signal serious interest in a US government Bitcoin accumulation strategy amid $40T national debt. The political alignment is real, and it changes the macro narrative from "crypto vs. regulation" to "crypto as fiscal hedge." What it means for your trade: This is long-term bullish for price, but don't hold your breath for an immediate move. Watch for actual policy bills, not just meetings. In the short term (24-48h), use this as a reason not to panic-sell the rips.

WATCH LIST

BTC Resistance & Support: Bulls need to hold $70,953 as the pivot. The 24h high of $69,902 is now in the rear-view; next target is $72,000+ on sustained momentum. If we fail to close above $70K today, watch for a retest of $68,500. ETH is tracking similar macro drivers—$2,318 is the recent high; a close above it opens $2,400. SOL is quieter but holding the $85+ zone as support. Funding rates are dead flat, so liquidations will be the volume driver, not leveraged buildup.

Sentiment Watch: Greed at 73/100 is hot enough to trigger profit-taking if we see a 1-2% daily close lower. Stablecoin reserves are fat at $255.3B, so the dry powder is there for dip-buyers, but the speed of the sentiment swing—46 to 62 in one day—is a yellow flag. Monitor the next 8-hour funding reset (due shortly) for any sign of new leverage entering; that's when the house of cards tests its balance.

See you tomorrow — stay sharp, secure your gains, and don't chase $71K on a manic Monday.
